主要内容: On March 23, 2012, SAP AG, a German-based company, issued a press release announcing the availability of its 2011 Annual Report and U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission filing on Form 20-F. The press release is included as Exhibit 99.1. Additionally, SAP announced new long-term incentive programs for employees and Executive Board members. The two webmessages referenced in the press release are also included as Exhibits 99.2 and 99.3. The document contains forward-looking statements, which are subject to risks and uncertainties. SAP undertakes no obligation to update these statements. The information is filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. The document titled 'Form 6-K' is dated March 27, 2012, and includes information about Dr. Christoph Huetten, who holds the title of Chief Accounting Officer. The filing contains an exhibit index with three exhibits, including a press release and two webmessages dated March 23, 2012. This document is part of the regulatory filings process in the United States, indicating the company's compliance with financial reporting standards. The content highlights the role of the Chief Accounting Officer and the inclusion of various communications related to the company's activities.
